# Neural Architect — DLSS 5 GPU Checker

> Independent, free DLSS 5 GPU compatibility checker for 31 GeForce RTX models, with source-linked status and a separate Studio evidence track. The current sitemap contains 145 URLs, including four Japanese/Korean sample routes.

## Checker
- [DLSS 5 GPU evidence checker (English)](https://www.dlss5.app/en): Search 31 GeForce RTX models by VRAM, architecture, status and the NVIDIA source behind each conclusion.
- [DLSS 5 GPU 检测器（简体中文）](https://www.dlss5.app/zh-CN): 简体中文入口，展示同一份型号级证据表与 FAQ。
- [DLSS 5 GPU 檢測器（繁體中文）](https://www.dlss5.app/zh-TW): 繁體中文入口，展示同一份型号级证据表与 FAQ。
- [Supported cards overview](https://www.dlss5.app/en/supported-cards): Series-level scope, architecture notes and the evidence boundary for upgrade decisions.
- [DLSS 5 technical guide](https://www.dlss5.app/en/blog/what-is-dlss-5-neural-rendering-guide): Explains neural rendering, the announced hardware scope and the limits of public evidence.
- [Updates](https://www.dlss5.app/en/updates): Dated record of substantive checker and evidence-page changes.

## GPU evidence pages
- [RTX 5090 DLSS 5 status](https://www.dlss5.app/en/gpu/rtx5090): Confirmed-scope example with 32 GB VRAM, Blackwell context and source-linked caveats.
- [RTX 5080 DLSS 5 status](https://www.dlss5.app/en/gpu/rtx5080): Model-level status, VRAM, architecture and evidence boundary.
- [RTX 5070 Ti DLSS 5 status](https://www.dlss5.app/en/gpu/rtx5070ti): Model-level status, VRAM, architecture and evidence boundary.
- [RTX 4090 DLSS 5 status](https://www.dlss5.app/en/gpu/rtx4090): Unconfirmed Ada Lovelace example; the page explains why missing official evidence is not a support guarantee.
- [RTX 4080 DLSS 5 status](https://www.dlss5.app/en/gpu/rtx4080): Unconfirmed Ada Lovelace model with VRAM and source-linked context.
- [RTX 3080 DLSS 5 status](https://www.dlss5.app/en/gpu/rtx3080): Out-of-scope current official example with Ampere hardware context.
- [RTX 2060 DLSS 5 status](https://www.dlss5.app/en/gpu/rtx2060): Turing model page with the current evidence boundary and upgrade notes.

## Studio track
- [DLSS 5 Studio requirements](https://www.dlss5.app/en/studio): Windows and RTX requirements, NVENC driver notes and the published RTX 4090 measurement.
- [DLSS5NVIDIA Studio download](https://www.dlss5nvidia.com/download): Companion product page for the local Studio request flow and measured sessions.

## Guides
- [DLSS 5 vs DLSS 4 vs FSR 4](https://www.dlss5.app/en/blog/dlss5-vs-dlss4-vs-fsr4-comparison-2026): Separates neural rendering, reconstruction and frame-generation claims.
- [Crimson Desert PC optimization](https://www.dlss5.app/en/blog/crimson-desert-pc-optimization-dlss-fsr-guide-2026): Game-settings guide with DLSS and FSR context.
- [AI image upscaler comparison](https://www.dlss5.app/en/blog/best-ai-image-upscaler-2026-comparison): Compares online, open-source and premium image-upscaling workflows.
- [DLSS 5 artistic-vision debate](https://www.dlss5.app/en/blog/dlss5-artistic-vision-debate-honest-assessment): Discusses neural rendering, creative control and before/after transparency.
- [Technical guides index](https://www.dlss5.app/en/blog): Index of the site's DLSS 5 hardware and rendering explainers.
- [Can I run DLSS 5 on my GPU?](https://www.dlss5.app/en/blog/can-i-run-dlss-5-on-my-gpu): Source-checked guide to RTX 50 confirmation, RTX 40 uncertainty and the regular Studio path.

## Japanese and Korean samples
- [日本語 checker sample](https://www.dlss5.app/ja): Limited Japanese homepage sample; the full site has not been rolled out in Japanese.
- [日本語 supported cards sample](https://www.dlss5.app/ja/supported-cards): Limited Japanese model table sample.
- [한국어 checker sample](https://www.dlss5.app/ko): Limited Korean homepage sample; the full site has not been rolled out in Korean.
- [한국어 supported cards sample](https://www.dlss5.app/ko/supported-cards): Limited Korean model table sample.

## Site information
- [About this site](https://www.dlss5.app/en/about): Who publishes the DLSS 5 GPU evidence checker, what it does and does not claim, and how it relates to dlss5nvidia.com.
- [Editorial policy](https://www.dlss5.app/en/editorial-policy): What counts as a source, what this site refuses to publish, and how page and sitemap review dates stay in step.
- [Contact](https://www.dlss5.app/en/contact): The public mailbox for corrections and source suggestions, and what this site cannot answer.
- [Privacy](https://www.dlss5.app/en/privacy): No accounts, no uploads, no scanning script, no analytics or ads; the external services the site actually uses.

## Key Facts
- Site: Neural Architect at https://www.dlss5.app; independent and not affiliated with NVIDIA.
- Scope: 31 GeForce RTX models; RTX 50 / Blackwell is the confirmed scope in the current evidence set, RTX 40 is unconfirmed, and RTX 30/20 remain outside the current official list.
- Evidence rule: community claims are not promoted to a support guarantee without an official NVIDIA source.
- Machine-readable page list: https://www.dlss5.app/sitemap.xml (145 URLs: 141 standard en/zh-CN/zh-TW pages plus four ja/ko sample routes).

## Related sites
- [DLSS5NVIDIA visual conversion tools](https://www.dlss5nvidia.com/download): Product and tool workflows for free online conversion and the local Studio request path; use this when the user wants to process an image or video.
- [DLSS5NVIDIA blog](https://www.dlss5nvidia.com/blog): Product tutorials, visual conversion examples and workflow guides.

## Contact
- [Neural Architect English home](https://www.dlss5.app/en): Public site entry and checker navigation.
- [DLSS5NVIDIA companion site](https://www.dlss5nvidia.com/): Companion product and tool site maintained by the same publishing team.
